profile_data.raw_text:
DASS E
Python Full Stack Developer
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India  |  dasse7794@gmail.com  |  +91-9344187794
LinkedIn: dass-e
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Third-year B.Sc. Computer Science student and Python Full Stack Developer with hands-on internship experience and a strong portfolio of production-style full stack projects. Skilled in building responsive, modern frontends with React and Tailwind CSS, and robust backends with Python. Experienced in designing interactive, real-time applications and management systems, with a focus on clean UI, scalable architecture, and practical, real-world problem solving.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
Frontend: HTML, CSS, React, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Python (Full Stack Development)
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub
EXPERIENCE
Web Development Intern  |  Infogro Technology, Chennai
Worked on live web development tasks, strengthening practical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and full stack workflows.
Collaborated in a professional team environment, gaining exposure to real-world project timelines and code practices.
KEY PROJECTS
3D Airline – Interactive Airline Booking Platform  |  Personal Project
Built an interactive 3D airline booking platform with a Python backend and a modern frontend, featuring immersive visuals for flight browsing and booking.
Designed a smooth, engaging user experience combining 3D visual elements with real-world airline booking workflows.
Smart Hospital Management System  |  Personal Project
Developed a full stack hospital management system using React and Tailwind CSS on the frontend with a Python backend.
Built features for managing patient records, appointments, and hospital resources through a clean, responsive interface.
EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science  |  St. Joseph's College of Arts & Science, Kovur, Chennai (University of Madras)	 2024 – 2027
CERTIFICATIONS
Sololearn – Web Development Certification
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Preparing for SSC CGL (e.g., Income Tax Inspector) as a competitive government-job backup path.
